name: Convergence Threshold
introDiscord:
Everything returns at once.

Moonlit coral.

Starfall crystal.

Whispering roots.

Leviathan bones.

Sunken palace stone.

Nexus starlight.

All six roads meet here.
introTwitch:
Everything returns at once.

Moonlit coral.

Starfall crystal.

Whispering roots.

Leviathan bones.

Sunken palace stone.

Nexus starlight.

All six roads meet here.

convergence-threshold-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Convergence Threshold.

left.message: A cache contains small pieces of the entire journey.

right.message: An Astral Convergence Warden guards the unified path.

forward.message: Every region's restorative magic overlaps for a brief moment.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

convergence-threshold-depths.prompt: Deeper within Convergence Threshold, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message: A Warden appears where six paths become one.

right.message: Star Candies orbit a map of the known Astral Sea.

forward.message:
One Berry rests on Shizuki's final map.

For once:

it is accurate.

She wrote:

'DO NOT TELL GLIMMER.

I need this moment.'

convergence-threshold-threshold.prompt: Near Heart-Crossing Seal, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: The final Warden blocks the Seal.

forward.message:
A chest bears symbols from Moonlit Reef, Starfall Trench, Whispering
Kelp Forest, Leviathan's Wake, Sunken King's Throne and Astral Nexus.

bossPromptDiscord:
Heart-Crossing Seal opens.

Behind it, every region appears at once.

A final guardian stands between the mapped Astral Sea and whatever lies
past it.

Use /yes to cross or /no to stand at the edge of the known
world a little longer.
bossPromptTwitch:
Heart-Crossing Seal opens.

Behind it, every region appears at once.

A final guardian stands between the mapped Astral Sea and whatever lies
past it.

Use !yes to cross or !no to stand at the edge of the known
world a little longer.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Heart-Crossing Seal. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Six currents form one towering guardian.

Nexus Prime Warden reveals itself!

completionText:
The Warden falls.

The Seal opens completely.

There is one final place within the Nexus.

Not a command center.

Not a laboratory.

Not an institution.

A heart.
